summary: Wrote a four-phase implementation plan adopting the research report's recommended candidate with one substitution: an unknown-flag refusal self-records a schema-valid refusal entry into the task's own issues.jsonl (carrying tags.issue_record_refusal and the caller's own --what-happened prose) and exits with a new distinct code 2, so the dropped evidence is recovered through a channel the prescribed >/dev/null 2>&1 redirection cannot reach and that an existing consumer already reads. Flag aliasing and a contract-wide stderr unswallowing are declined with grounds under the plan's Decisions section, and the three call-site scripts in file_scope are deliberately left unedited. Phases: mechanism plus header contract, four regression cases, documentation parity plus the agent-facing discoverability pointer and the regenerated index line_count, then a redeploy with default-mode verification. Plan-time premise re-validation confirmed the defect live with drifted line numbers, and found that CORE_TEST_SUBJECT_MODE=source-store removes the deploy-before-exercise step the description assumed.
